student_answer:
Binary Search is a searching technique used on sorted list. It first checks the middle element and compares it with the value being searched for. If the value is smaller, it searches the left if it is larger it searches the right half. This process continues until the element is found or no elements remain to search
Time complexity: O(logn)
reference_answer: Binary search works on a sorted list. It compares the target with the middle element, discards the half that cannot contain the target, and repeats until the item is found or the search interval is empty. Its time complexity is O(log n).
